Acting: A video of people acting out a scene.
Spoken Performance: A video of a person performing spoken word, poetry, or rap.
Instrumental Performance: A video of people playing musical instruments.
Rehearsal: A video of people rehearsing and practicing a performance.
Group Performance: A video of a group of people performing together.
Solo Performance: A video of one person performing alone.
Presenting Creative Work: A video of a person presenting their artwork or creative project.
